basic_info.description:
Open House:
Saturday 11/15 12-2pm
Sunday 11/16, 2-4pm

Classic San Francisco home located in the heart of the Marina. Two large bedrooms with walk-in closets, updated full bathroom and powder room, gourmet kitchen with high end appliances and built-in breakfast nook, spacious dining room, and living room with bay windows and gas fireplace. Three additional closets provide ample storage. 

This Marina gem boasts plenty of natural light, original hardwood floors throughout, new lighting, and shared access to a beautiful backyard garden. Enjoy your private patio deck located off of the primary bedroom, overlooking the shared garden. 

Enjoy all that the Marina has to offer - just two blocks from Chestnut shops and restaurants and a 5-minute walk to Marina Green. In-unit laundry. All utilities included, except Internet/Cable by tenant. Parking is available for an additional $400/month. 

If interested, Matterport 3D tour available upon request. Unit is available now.

One year lease preferred. Open to short term lease at adjusted monthly rate. All utilities paid by owner except internet/cable by tenant.
